annotations.title: Ask the user to upload a file

description: Create a one-hour link where the user uploads an image or video in their browser while signed in to PostQuickAI. Use this for any file the user has, including files shared in this chat. Share uploadPageUrl, wait for the user to say it is done, then call getUploadLink.

mediaKind.description: Images: JPEG, PNG, WebP, or GIF up to 10MB. Videos: MP4, WebM, or MOV up to 500MB.

name: createUploadLink
